questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.solution: Canberra is the capital of Australia. It was selected as the capital in 1908 as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.questionHtml: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.solution: The Nile River is generally considered the longest river in the world, stretching approximately 6,650 km (4,130 miles) in length.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: What is the largest ocean in the world?
questions.questionHtml: What is the largest ocean in the world?
questions.solution: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean in the world, covering about 63 million square miles (165 million square kilometers).
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.questionHtml: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.solution: Mars is known as the Red Planet because of its reddish appearance, which is due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: What is the highest mountain peak in the world?
questions.questionHtml: What is the highest mountain peak in the world?
questions.solution: Mount Everest is the highest mountain peak in the world, with an elevation of 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) above sea level.
